rationale: The user decision adds a controller power/service architecture constraint and a dependent RF/power reliability requirement. Existing evolving requirements are synchronized through MCP so that they delegate controller-service behavior to the new source of truth; the verified historical requirement remains unchanged and is superseded only through the new requirement's V2-scoped trace.

affected_existing_reqs.diff_summary: Delegate the changed controller-service clauses to the new requirement without replacing the switch/diode requirement.
Delegate battery/service envelopes to the new requirement without replacing the housing requirement.
Preserve the verified historical X3 rule while overriding it only for target kc2-x3-v2.

scope_boundary_impact.rationale: The user explicitly approved the new architecture and requested SRS update followed by implementation.
